claim: On the definition CSET used for its US$6.8 billion 2019 EDA figure (CAE, IC physical design and verification, PCB/MCM and services, excluding semiconductor IP), the ESD Alliance's four 2025 quarterly releases sum to about US$13.35 billion for calendar 2025.
evidence: Total minus SIP per release: Q1 2025 $5,098.3m - $2,044.8m = $3,053.5m; Q2 $5,089.4m - $1,826.7m = $3,262.7m; Q3 $5,566.4m - $1,915.7m = $3,650.7m; Q4 $5,466.3m - $2,083.2m = $3,383.1m; sum $13,350.0m. CSET fn 189: $6.8bn "includes four segments ... CAE ...; PCB and MCM; ... physical design and verification; and services" and "separates the core IP market".

metric.name: EDA revenue excluding semiconductor IP (sum of four quarters)
metric.population: CAE + IC physical design & verification + PCB/MCM + services revenue of companies reporting to the ESD Alliance EDMD
metric.methodology: Sum of four quarterly EDMD press-release totals minus the SIP category; as-first-reported quarterly values

notes: Fact-check fc-W0-4ca0 update to CLM-0415 (CSET's US$6.8bn is CY2019). Roughly doubled since 2019 on a like-for-like ESD Alliance basis. Including SIP, CY2025 total is about US$21.2bn (see CLM-2242). Q1 2025 uses the figure as first reported (July 2025 release).
